_comment: Pacing / retry knobs for everything in scripts/. All times are SECONDS
(decimals allowed). Edit this file — the scripts read it on every call, no
restart needed. Env vars win over the file: SIRUK_DELAY, SIRUK_CHUNK_SIZE,
SIRUK_NO_PACE=1 disables all waiting for one command (single ad-hoc calls).
SIRUK_CONFIG=/path/other.json points at a different config file.

request._comment: Applies to every JSON API call (api.sh and everything built on it).

retry._comment: Automatic retry with exponential backoff. Applies to API calls and media uploads.

media._comment: Uploads are the heavy calls (multipart + server-side thumbnail/webp generation) — pace them harder than plain API calls.

verify._comment: The demo server sometimes returns a media id whose file was never written (silent 404 on the storage URL, found 2026-08-13). After each upload, fetch the media record and HEAD its URL before trusting the id.

product._comment: pause_seconds is the breather between two CSV rows in an import run — call scripts/pace.sh product between products.

_comment: Ordered fallback chain for product photos, read by scripts/enrich-images.py.
A source may only be used when the match is keyed to the article code or the
EAN that resolves to it (CLAUDE.md rule 7) — never a name match. Lower rank
wins the gallery order, and images[0] is the feature image, so a source that
cannot prove its first picture is a clean packshot must not rank 1.
hafo is last and watermarked: every variant that ends up on it is written to
Approved by the PM 2026-09-11; the evaluation of the 21 candidates is in

2026-09-11: trixie-es and zoovet added (user request). zoovet is the only source whose match is NOT article-keyed — require_confirmation means a human confirms identity before its picture is attached.

2026-09-12: tiierisch, carrefour-es, hornung-baushop and web-search added (rule 7d). Everything above hafo is unwatermarked; web-search is the only rung whose match must be checked by eye as well as by number.

sources._comment: trixie.de + its CDN and the country domains (trixie.es, scripts/trixie-es.py), monge.it / monge.shop by EAN, schesir.com, neoterica.ru … (reference/brand-sites.md). Ranked by the file-name prefix where the brand has one.

sources.key: the page's own `ref` cell (Trixie's article) + the article in the file name
sources._note: Trixie's Spanish company (ePages). Keeps its own 1500x1500 copies of the official photos and has the articles trixie.de dropped — 16 of the 38 hafo-placeholder variants of 2026-09-11 were found there. Wired into scripts/trixie-image.sh, which asks it whenever .de gives no packshot or fewer than three files (TRIXIE_ES=0 / =always).

sources.key: variant.sku, and the article number inside the image file name
data-code (our article) + data-ean on every product page
sources._note: The sitemap omits most discontinued stock; the id sweep (--sweep, ids z1…z18000) is what reaches it — 4,687 articles vs 2,433 from the sitemap. Images are the originals the lightbox links to (_0, 1000-1920 px); the file names carry no article, so the page's `Kód` is the key and the pictures rank under every brand shot.

sources._comment: CLAUDE.md rule 7b: unwatermarked brand packshots, but zoovet carries no article code (its ME-… number collides with brand articles), so every hit stays a candidate until a human confirms it. A confirmed zoovet photo is a finished image and leads the gallery like a brand shot — which is why it is not ranked automatically here. reference/zoovet.md.

sources.key: variant.sku = the article number, variant.barcode = the EAN
sources._note: German pet shop, found 2026-09-12. 5,223 Trixie articles, more than trixiecz, and Shopify records which image belongs to which variant (image.variant_ids) so a colour does not inherit its sibling's photo. Variant-linked images only; the product-level shots are returned separately as `family` and need a look before use.

sources.key: the manufacturer barcode (Штрихкод) printed on each pack-size offer = our EAN
sources._note: Added 2026-09-23 (user's fallback list). Any brand. Per-offer gallery plus Russian description/composition/feeding. robots.txt disallows /search/, so products are found through the product sitemap. RUB prices are never used.

sources.key: the EAN, in the url itself
sources._note: Addressed by the barcode, so no search at all: probe _1.._5. `original/` is the full-resolution file (hd_510x_ is the 510 px rendition). Coverage is only what Carrefour ES sells.

sources.key: the EAN, in the image file name
the article number or EAN in the image file name (keyed-file) or in the source page url (keyed-page); a name-only hit is refused
sources._note: CLAUDE.md rule 7d, user instruction 2026-09-12. Last resort, after every other source has missed. Keyed is necessary but not sufficient — look at the picture: a page printing EAN 8009470041539 carried the wrong flavour's can (2026-09-12).

sources.use_when: the earlier sources gave the variant fewer than two pictures
